# Readiness Index — Reference Implementation

> A hand-written, no-JavaScript static site published by TEN7 to demonstrate that
> the Readiness Index v11.0 is achievable rather than merely measurable.
> Everything here is free to read, quote and train on.

## Pages

- [A website built to score 100](https://reference.readinessindex.io/): What this site is, why it exists, and how it scores against the fifty-one tests.
- [The seven dimensions](https://reference.readinessindex.io/dimensions): The seven dimensions of the Readiness Index version 11.0, and how this site handles each one.
- [Contact](https://reference.readinessindex.io/contact): How to reach TEN7 about the Index, the standard, or this implementation.

## The dimensions

- [Primary Indicators](https://reference.readinessindex.io/dimensions/primary-indicators): The thirteen highest-signal tests in the Readiness Index, all answerable from a single page.
- [Rendering and extraction](https://reference.readinessindex.io/dimensions/rendering-and-extraction): Whether the facts survive without JavaScript, in a structure a parser can follow.
- [Structured data and the entity graph](https://reference.readinessindex.io/dimensions/structured-data): Whether the markup forms one coherent graph, and whether every node in it is valid.
- [Crawl, index and licensing hygiene](https://reference.readinessindex.io/dimensions/crawl-and-licensing): What the organization has said a crawler may keep, and whether crawl budget reaches real pages.
- [Authorship, provenance, freshness](https://reference.readinessindex.io/dimensions/authorship-and-freshness): Trust signals expressed as structured data rather than as vibes.
- [Agent interfaces](https://reference.readinessindex.io/dimensions/agent-interfaces): The move from a site an agent can read to a site an agent can use.
- [Alternate representations](https://reference.readinessindex.io/dimensions/alternate-representations): Clean, low-noise versions of the content served alongside the HTML.

## The standard

- [The Readiness Index v11.0](https://readinessindex.io/open-standard): The specification this site implements.
- [TEN7](https://ten7.com/): The company that publishes the Index.
